full_prompt_en: A square classical oil painting shows an elderly man seated at a table in a dark room, beside a polished metal helmet and scattered papers. He fills the center and right foreground, leaning his left cheek into one hand while looking upward toward the upper left with an amused, thoughtful expression. Short curled gray hair frames his high forehead, and a small gray beard and fine wrinkles are visible in the warm light. He wears a loose olive brown coat over a darker inner garment, with broad sleeves falling into deep folds around the table edge. His other arm rests low near the right side of the frame. On the round tabletop at lower left, the silver gray helmet catches bright curved reflections and sits next to pale paper sheets and a dark ink vessel or small object. Behind it, a carved animal head or sculptural bust emerges from shadow near the far left. In the upper right background, an arched opening reveals a softly painted classical building and tiny indistinct figures, its cool blue gray distance contrasting with the near brown interior. Most of the upper and left background remains almost black, so the face, hand, and helmet become the luminous focus. Fine brushwork carefully models the skin and reflective metal, while the coat and dark furnishings are handled in broader, quieter masses. Warm light enters from the upper left, brightening the man's face and hand and glancing across the helmet before falling away behind him. The overall composition is intimate and theatrical, pairing human reverie with a cluster of old objects in a deep, warm shadow.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形古典油画描绘一位老人坐在昏暗房间的桌边，旁边摆着发亮的金属头盔与散开的纸张。他占据中央及右侧前景，左脸靠在一只手上，目光朝左上抬起，神情带一点愉快和沉思。短而卷曲的灰发围住高额头，暖光里能看见小小灰胡须和细纹。他穿宽松的橄榄棕外套，里面是较暗的衣服，宽大袖子在桌边形成深褶。另一只手臂低低放在画面右侧附近。左下方的圆桌面上，银灰色头盔接住弯曲的亮光，旁边是浅色纸页与深色墨水器皿或小物件。头盔后面，雕刻的动物头或塑像从最左侧阴影中浮现。右上背景，一处拱形开口露出柔和描绘的古典建筑与细小模糊人物，冷蓝灰色远景对照近处棕色室内。上方和左侧大部分背景近乎漆黑，使面孔、手和头盔成为明亮焦点。细笔触仔细塑造皮肤与反光金属，外套和深色家具则以更宽阔安静的体块处理。暖光从左上进入，照亮老人面孔和手，掠过头盔，然后在身后衰减。整体构图亲密而富有戏剧性，在深暖阴影中把人的沉思与一组旧物并置。
style_prompt_en: Classical oil painting concentrates precise tonal modeling and reflective highlights within a deep umber and charcoal surround. Warm flesh like peach, dull olive, aged brown, silver gray, and small cool blue accents create a restrained color hierarchy. Rounded forms emerge gradually from shadow, and the sharpest edges appear only where light catches a focal contour or polished surface. Broad dark folds and furnishings merge into one enclosing mass, giving the foreground light a theatrical presence. A small distant cool opening provides depth beyond the intimate near space without competing for attention. Brushwork is smooth and detailed in illuminated passages, then broader and less resolved in shade. Light enters obliquely from above one side, travels over raised planes, and vanishes quickly into deep recesses. The overall effect is contemplative and richly atmospheric, relying on selective illumination more than decorative color.
style_prompt_zh: 古典油画把精确的明暗塑形和反光高光集中在深棕褐与炭色环绕之中。暖桃色、暗橄榄色、旧棕色、银灰与少量冷蓝构成克制的色彩层级。圆润形体逐渐从阴影浮现，最清晰的边缘只在光触及焦点轮廓或光滑表面时出现。宽阔的深色褶面和布置融为包围性的整体，使前景亮部具有舞台感。一处小而冷的远方开口把空间延伸出亲密的近处，却不争夺注意力。受光处笔触平滑而细致，暗处更宽阔，也不完全明确。光从一侧上方斜入，掠过凸起平面，并迅速消失在深凹处。整体效果沉思而富有浓郁空气感，依靠选择性照明胜过装饰性色彩。
theme_en: An elderly man at a table beside a metal helmet
theme_zh: 一位老人坐在桌旁，身边放着金属头盔
name: Charles-Andre van Loo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
